Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that creates a project in Maxwell 2D using the PyAEDT library and runs a transient simulation. The code should import necessary libraries, set non-graphical mode, insert a Maxwell 2D design and save the project. It should create a rectangle and duplicate it, create an air region, assign windings to the sheets and a balloon to the air region, and plot the model. The code should also create a transient setup, create a rectangular plot, solve the model, create output and plot it using PyVista, generate the same plot outside AEDT, and finally close AEDT.

You can find the following APIs from the library helpful:
icepak_a, point_a, hfss3dl_a, test_54b_open_and_load_a_polyline, duplicate_and_mirror, duplicate_and_unite, test_09b_export_report_A, move_and_connect_to, create_air_region, set_position_and_rotation, create_port_between_pin_and_layer, plot_2d_chart, plot_2d_cut, test_06_duplicate_and_mirror, rectangular_plot, get_position_and_rotation, get_version_and_release, check_and_download_file, check_and_download_folder, array_center_and_edge

```python
from pyaedt import Maxwell2d
from pyaedt import Desktop
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pyvista as pv

# Launch AEDT in non-graphical mode
desktop = Desktop(specified_version="2024.1", non_graphical=True, new_desktop_session=True)

# Create Maxwell 2D project and design
maxwell2d = Maxwell2d(projectname="Maxwell2D_Transient_Project", designname="TransientDesign", solution_type="Transient")

# Create a rectangle
rect1 = maxwell2d.modeler.create_rectangle(position=[0, 0], dimension_list=[10, 5], name="Rect1", matname="copper")

# Duplicate the rectangle
rect2 = maxwell2d.modeler.duplicate_and_move(rect1, [0, 10])
rect2.name = "Rect2"

# Create air region
air_region = maxwell2d.modeler.create_air_region(x_pos=0, y_pos=0, z_pos=0, x_size=30, y_size=30, z_size=1, name="AirRegion")

# Assign windings to the sheets
winding1 = maxwell2d.assign_winding(rect1.name, winding_type="Current", current_value=10, name="Winding1")
winding2 = maxwell2d.assign_winding(rect2.name, winding_type="Current", current_value=-10, name="Winding2")

# Assign balloon boundary to air region
maxwell2d.assign_balloon(air_region.faces[0])

# Plot the model
maxwell2d.plot(show=False, export_path="model_plot.png")

# Create a transient setup
setup = maxwell2d.create_setup("TransientSetup")
setup.props["StopTime"] = "10ms"
setup.props["TimeStep"] = "0.1ms"
setup.update()

# Create a rectangular plot (field plot)
plot = maxwell2d.post.create_fieldplot_surface(maxwell2d.modeler.objects, "Mag_B", plot_type="Rectangular", name="MagneticFieldPlot")

# Solve the model
maxwell2d.analyze_nominal()

# Create output: get B field on a cut plane and plot with PyVista
cut_plane = maxwell2d.post.create_fieldplot_cutplane(objname=air_region.name, quantity="Mag_B", cut_plane="XY", position=0)
field_data = maxwell2d.post.get_solution_data_per_object("Mag_B", setup_sweep_name="TransientSetup : LastAdaptive", objects=[air_region.name])

# Plot using PyVista
mesh = pv.read("{}.vtk".format(cut_plane.name))
plotter = pv.Plotter()
plotter.add_mesh(mesh, scalars="Mag_B", cmap="viridis")
plotter.show(screenshot="pyvista_plot.png")

# Generate the same plot outside AEDT using matplotlib
x = field_data.primary_sweep_values
y = field_data.data_real("Mag_B")
plt.figure()
plt.plot(x, y)
plt.xlabel("Position")
plt.ylabel("Magnetic Flux Density (T)")
plt.title("Mag_B along cut plane")
plt.savefig("matplotlib_plot.png")
plt.close()

# Save the project
maxwell2d.save_project()

# Close AEDT
maxwell2d.release_desktop(close_projects=True, close_desktop=True)
```
